historical_record.description: The site then held a ground-level asphalt parking lot on a portion of the site, with the remainder vacant.
The City Planning Commission upheld the mitigated negative declaration for new construction of 87 affordable housing units with retail, childcare, and community spaces in three buildings.
The City Planning Commission approved the general plan referral for a new mid-rise building containing 87 units of affordable housing with retail, childcare, and community spaces.
The City Planning Commission approved a certificate of appropriateness for new construction within the Northeast Waterfront Historic District.
The City Planning Commission approved conditional-use authorization for a planned unit development to construct three new mid-rise buildings with 87 affordable housing units.
